mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a good human relation officer so as to win the unalloyed support of the principal."
He/she should show that he/she is a good human relation officer so as to win the unalloyed support of the principal.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a service that is universal - not confined to the school or the family."
Guidance programme is a service that is universal - not confined to the school or the family.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an objective and standardized measure of sample of behaviour or character."
A psychological test is an objective and standardized measure of sample of behaviour or character.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means more that to the individual."
Guidance means more that to the individual.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the application of psychological techniques by a trained clinician to solve people's problems."
Psychotherapy is the application of psychological techniques by a trained clinician to solve people's problems.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means monitoring of individual with a view of obtaining regular progress report on his performance and how satisfied he is with either his job or academic performance."
Follow-up means monitoring of individual with a view of obtaining regular progress report on his performance and how satisfied he is with either his job or academic performance.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a broad one demanding various roles and responsibilities from all personnel in the system."
The school guidance programme is a broad one demanding various roles and responsibilities from all personnel in the system.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an integral part of guidance programme."
Evaluation is an integral part of guidance programme.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the focus of the guidance programme in schools."
The students are the focus of the guidance programme in schools.
